thread:
maria: T-minus ~36h to cutoff for the next release. Target bump to v2.5.0-rc1. Please run a green-sweep and flag flakes. I'll lock the release branch at T-8h. @jen @sasha please coordinate.

sasha: On it — starting a full green-sweep now across linux/mac/windows runners. Will post CI links.

ci-bot: ci-green-sweep started: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/9823 · running 34 jobs

dan: Heads up: I have one PR with a changelog entry pending review (PATCH). If that blocks, can we include it post-cutoff? @maria

maria: If it's patch-only and doesn't touch infra, we can backport post-cutoff. If it's API or config, we need it now. Share PR link.

dan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234 — just docs and changelog. I'll mark as post-cutoff.

jen: Seeing two flaky tests in integration-suite: `session_reconnect` and `kv-cache-timeout`. Re-running those specific tests now. Adding them to the flaky bucket: `/flake-buckets/precut-2-5`

sasha: Nice. If they reproduce on rerun, I'll try a focused bisect. For the reruns, use `bazel test //integration:session_reconnect --runs_per_test=5`

ci-bot: job 9823.14 failed: integration/session_reconnect (flake). Re-run queued.

jen: Rerun got green for `session_reconnect` x4. Marking it as flaky and adding a stability note in the ticket. `kv-cache-timeout` still failing on mac.

lee: I can take mac flakes. Will SSH into the mac agent and run with `--no-caf` to isolate. ETA 45m.

patrick: Changelog reminder: please add concise 1-line entries under `Unreleased` for any user-facing changes. Ping me if you need format help. :memo: 

maria: Thanks. Also reminder to pin the runtime image before branch lock: `docker tag redwood/serve:canary redwood/serve:v2.5.0-rc1`. I'll post lock time (T-8h) in ~2h.

sasha: CI link: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/9823/output · overall green = 28/34 passing, 6 flaky/rerunning.

jen: Added `/flake-buckets/precut-2-5/session_reconnect` and `/flake-buckets/precut-2-5/kv-cache-timeout`. Tickets: #4567, #4568.

maria: Perfect. If anyone hits a blocker in the next 6h, call it out here and tag @oncall. Otherwise we'll proceed with lock at T-8h and start the candidate release pipeline. :rocket:
